topic: Information Consumption - Technical Deep Dive Request

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I need comprehensive technical documentation. Specifically, your network topology, redundancy architecture, and latency performance data across all your POPs.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. I'll provide our complete technical architecture guide, real-time latency heatmaps, and redundancy schematics. What specific use cases should I focus the performance data on?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We run high-frequency trading algorithms that are latency-sensitive. Also need BGP routing policies and DDoS mitigation technical specifications.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: For HFT applications, I'll include our sub-millisecond routing optimizations, BGP policy examples for financial services, and our behavioral DDoS detection algorithms. I'll also arrange lab access for latency testing.
